item.title: Discover where Greater Manchester is heading next
item.description: We’ve spent the best part of a year taking a virtual tour around Greater Manchester – punctuated by my charity Wanderwalk tour in July – exploring how each local authority is approaching regeneration and housing delivery to meet their own local needs, writes Euan Kellie of Euan Kellie Property Solutions. The post Discover where Greater Manchester is heading next appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: CWAC makes top 5 for unspent S106 healthcare contributions
item.description: With £4.5m, Cheshire West and Chester Council has nearly eight times the average of unspent Section 106 money allocated for health and social care. The post CWAC makes top 5 for unspent S106 healthcare contributions appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: BrewDog to close four bars in region after pre-pack deal
item.description: Once the darling of UK craft brewing, the £33m sale of the firm to US buyer Tilray has led to 38 confirmed venue closures, with Manchester’s Peter Street one of just 11 locations to survive. The post BrewDog to close four bars in region after pre-pack deal appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: GALLERY | Nexus completes Liverpool resi
item.description: Main contractor Legacie has delivered the 174-home Central Park project on a brownfield site in the Baltic Triangle. The post GALLERY | Nexus completes Liverpool resi appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Kier publishes improved half-year results
item.description: The contractor has reported growth in revenue and pre-tax profit for the six months between 1 July 2025 and 31 December 2025. The post Kier publishes improved half-year results appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Glenbrook unveils plans to breathe life into Manchester ‘dead space’
item.description: The developer has launched a consultation on its plans to redevelop the Northern Quarter’s Church Street multi-storey car park into around 300 homes. The post Glenbrook unveils plans to breathe life into Manchester ‘dead space’ appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Davos, Beetham rebrand Liverpool skyscraper cluster as Kings
item.description: The £1bn scheme hitherto referred to as King Edward Triangle has been given a new moniker in a move the developers said “illustrates Liverpool’s confidence”. The post Davos, Beetham rebrand Liverpool skyscraper cluster as Kings appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Shenton offloads Northern Quarter bar, seeks sale of upper floors
item.description: Urban Village Bars, which is in situ as operator of The Wayfarer, has bought the ground floor and basement of 1-5 Swan Street for £1.4m from the Manchester property firm. The post Shenton offloads Northern Quarter bar, seeks sale of upper floors appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Seddon, Crown Estate push Cheshire East plans forward
item.description: An EIA screening request has been lodged by the Bolton developer as it plots 275 homes near Nantwich, while a £32m low-carbon scheme near Knutsford has cleared the hurdle. The post Seddon, Crown Estate push Cheshire East plans forward appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Wirral mulls sale of Birkenhead and Wallasey town halls
item.description: A review into the council’s estate has found that the cost of maintaining the listed civic buildings would amount to £35m over the next 50 years. The post Wirral mulls sale of Birkenhead and Wallasey town halls appeared first on Place North West.
